about.title: About me
about.text: Cloud Support Engineer specializing in the Microsoft 365 Security and Identity ecosystem (Defender, Purview, Entra ID), with a backend development background in TypeScript and Node.js. Before tech, I spent years leading hospitality teams in high-pressure environments, which shaped how I handle incidents, communicate with customers and take ownership of problems.

items.title: Industrial maintenance & logistics
items.text: Industrial gases company: AutoCAD piping design for liquid nitrogen and oxygen tankers, on-site team leadership and warehouse stock control.

items.title: Hospitality
items.text: Professional bartending and team leadership in hotels, restaurants and large events (Barcelona).

items.title: Back to tech
items.text: CAD/3D design courses (CIM-UPC), then ITS Python (2023).

items.title: Career switch
items.text: Backend Developer NodeJS (Barcelona Activa / IT Academy), ITA-WIKI project, hackathons.

items.title: Cloud security
items.text: Cloud Support Engineer, Microsoft 365, at Concentrix.

tech.text: Level 2 technical support for Microsoft 365 enterprise environments, resolving complex incidents on security, identity and compliance across Defender, Entra ID, Purview, Exchange Online and Azure, aligned with Microsoft best practices.

Agile/Scrum team. Maintained and extended backend services (TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL). Led the database migration from Prisma to Knex.js for performance and scalability. Built an AI-powered feature that generates descriptive text for new resources.
Real-time chat with Socket.io; API design and architecture; Agile methodology; intro to Go.

items.text: Bar operations for large-scale events: music festivals, corporate parties, motorsport hospitality. Team planning, logistics and service under high volume.
Hotel opening team: cocktail creation, team training, bar organization, staff planning and supplier orders.
Led bar teams, created cocktail menus, production and mise en place, managed floor and bar service (PAX 49: bar + floor).

hospitality.earlier: Lead Bartender at The Corner Hotel (4*, NN Hotels, 2017–2018); Surf House (2017); Lead Bartender at Ikibana and cellar work at La Textil Collective brewery (2023).
